payload.explanation: Diagnostic report identifies session_5fa6eedf309c as the root blocker: it is idle in transaction holding an uncommitted row lock on inventory product_id=1, blocking the business UPDATE in session_c9cd09b4a799. State report confirms session_5fa6eedf309c is eligible for rollback_session under policy, while the business session has no allowed actions. Rolling back the blocker releases the lock, letting the business decrement complete to expected stock 99.
